notes: The Campaign Header has no Start field, so start.raw is assembled from its NPC Name / Zone / pos lines rather than quoted from one field. CAMPAIGN RANK: the wikitext has 'Campaign Rank={{question}}' (the rendered page shows '(empty)'), so the rank gate is not merely unmodellable, it is unknown -- it is NOT put in gates.level, which is character level, and the header's 'Level: Any' is what makes gates.level null. Time is also {{question}}, hence time_limit_unknown. The giver is not the NPC you work with: Emhi Tchaoryo takes the op at (H-9), but bullets 2 and 7 both send you to Pelpopo at (G-9). This page names no zone for (G-9); BG Wiki's cached 'Windurst Waters (S)' zone page lists a Zone NPC Row 'Pelpopo ... (G-9)', and that is the only reason steps 1 and 3 carry a zone -- said here because it is a looked-up fact, not this page's. Non-steps: bullet 1 ('Solo mission') is a party constraint; bullets 4 and 6 are advice about the Fiendtrapper and about plates not stacking; bullets 9-12 are cross-references to Deep Cover I (W) and III (W) (including 'You must drop the Fiendtrapper to start Deep Cover III (W)'), which are not prerequisites of THIS op, so gates.prev stays []. Step 2 gets {"type":"none","name":null}: the wikitext target is '[[:Category:Yagudo|Yagudos]]', a category link, not a monster name, so mobs is [] too. Step 2 also carries no evidence -- bullet 6 says each picture 'will create a Fiend Plate with the mob's name on it', so the in-game item may not be the bare 'Fiend Plate' the wiki links, and an evidence item that never reads true is worse than none. The op ENDS at Pelpopo: bullet 8 says the mission is complete once 3 plates are accepted, and the page never sends you back to Emhi Tchaoryo (the sibling Cut and Cauterize I (W) does have such a step, so its absence here is the page's own reading, not an oversight of mine). Three plates must be ACCEPTED and rejects do not count, which no packet reports: count_unobservable.

steps.note: bullet 3 is the outcome of bullet 2, not a step: Pelpopo hands over a Fiendtrapper and 5 Blank F. Plates. Only the Fiendtrapper is evidence -- the blank plates are spent as you photograph, so holding 5 is true for a moment only. The zone is from BG Wiki's 'Windurst Waters (S)' zone page; this page gives the grid alone.

photograph Yagudos with the Fiendtrapper, from the front only. traded one plate at a time (bullet 7) until 3 are ACCEPTED (bullet 8), which is where the op completes -- there is no return to Emhi Tchaoryo on this page. count 3 is the requirement, but rejected plates do not count toward it, so more may be needed and nothing observable distinguishes them.
